rule.consequence: diagnose the cause before seed 1's scores are used as a stable baseline for SFT v2 thresholds
inconsistent_if_any: the three seeds do not all reach the same v3 decision
P1 (instruction following in distribution) differs between any two seeds with Holm-adjusted exact McNemar p < 0.05

note: n = 3 seeds: spread is descriptive; item intervals are per seed; no pooling across seeds
